feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 18 August 2026 8:16am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 18 August 2026 at 8:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Locally strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the northwest of the British isles, with various fronts affecting the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

West 4 or 5, locally 6 at first, becoming 3 or 4 for a time this evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Showers, merging into longer spells of rain later this evening. Becoming mainly fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 4 or 5, soon backing southwest for a time, gradually veering northerly 2 to 4 early on Wednesday night, then increasing 4 to 6 later in the night.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then scattered showers soon developing.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
